data.gender_notes: Nasiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nasiya is an Arabic name for a fragrant flower. Its beautiful and delicate meaning embodies the grace, beauty, and fragility of nature. The name Nasiya carries the meaning “Fragrant flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nasiya usually hope their child will grow to embody fragrant flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nasiya represents the spiritual journey of growth, transformation, and rebirth. It is a reminder to remain rooted in faith and to bloom in the presence of Allah.
data.etymology: Nasiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fragrant flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nasiya total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
